text: Appeal of Order to Comply for 40 Moon Valley Drive.

The Property Standards Committee, Etobicoke York Panel: 1. Confirmed the Order to Comply, dated February 13, 2018, regarding the property located at 40 Moon Valley Drive, for Items 1 to 9 inclusive. 2. Rescinded Item 10 only, for the Order to Comply, dated February 13, 2018, regarding the property located at 40 Moon Valley Drive.
